title: RWA Weekly Market Cap Report With Token Terminal
description: Weekly market cap growth across stablecoins, funds, U.S. T-bills, credit and stocks.

blocks.text: This is the weekly edition of RWA Activity on the Terminal, a joint report from RWA Foundation and Token Terminal. It tracks market cap growth over the past 7 days across five categories: stablecoins, tokenized funds, tokenized U.S. T-bills, tokenized credit funds and tokenized stocks. Each category is broken down by issuer and by chain.

parts.text: This is the weekly edition of RWA Activity on the Terminal, a joint report from RWA Foundation and Token Terminal. It tracks market cap growth over the past 7 days across five categories: stablecoins, tokenized funds, tokenized U.S. T-bills, tokenized credit funds and tokenized stocks. Each category is broken down by issuer and by chain.

blocks.text: All figures are taken strictly from Token Terminal as of October 5,2026. Growth figures cover the 7-day window from September 28 to October 5. No third-party data has been added, and no figures have been adjusted or estimated.

blocks.text: Market cap refers to circulating asset market cap as reported by Token Terminal. Each chart shows the issuers or chains listed by Token Terminal for that category. Tokenized U.S. T-bills and tokenized credit funds are subsets of tokenized funds, so some issuers appear in more than one category with the same figure.

blocks.text: Overview

parts.text: Overview

blocks.text: Stablecoins recorded the largest moves of the week. Open Standard added $626.3 million, Falcon Finance $447.4 million and Tether $329.3 million, and Tempo led all chains with $463.8 million.

parts.text: Stablecoins recorded the largest moves of the week. Open Standard added $626.3 million, Falcon Finance $447.4 million and Tether $329.3 million, and Tempo led all chains with $463.8 million.

blocks.text: In tokenized funds, Sky added $139.6 million, followed by J.P. Morgan (+$81.4 million) and Franklin Templeton (+$72.6 million). Ethereum and Stellar took almost all of the growth by chain. In tokenized stocks, bStocks added $94.9 million and BNB Chain $96.8 million. Tokenized credit grew on Ethereum and Monad only, and Pareto fell $31.2 million.

blocks.text: Stablecoins

parts.text: Stablecoins

blocks.text: Open Standard added $626.3 million in stablecoin market cap over 7 days, more than any other issuer. Falcon Finance (+$447.4 million) and Tether (+$329.3 million) followed. The three added about $1.4 billion between them, roughly 77% of the growth across the top 10.

blocks.text: Sky (+$125.0 million) and USDai (+$117.3 million) each added more than $100 million. United Stables (+$75.5 million) and Paxos (+$73.6 million) came next, with Arcus (+$13.3 million), Ripple (+$12.3 million) and Saturn (+$10.1 million) completing the top 10.

blocks.text: By chain, Tempo added $463.8 million, more than Tron (+$213.0 million) and Solana (+$151.5 million) combined. Arbitrum One (+$132.1 million) and Base (+$124.6 million) also added more than $100 million each. XRP Ledger added $98.4 million, Arc $54.1 million and BNB Chain $45.4 million. Robinhood Chain (+$26.6 million) and Monad (+$21.7 million).

blocks.text: Tokenized funds

parts.text: Tokenized funds

blocks.text: Sky led tokenized funds with $139.6 million in growth. J.P. Morgan added $81.4 million and Franklin Templeton $72.6 million. Maple Finance (+$34.8 million) and Figure (+$29.7 million) followed, then 3Jane (+$20.3 million), Hastra (+$19.7 million) and Ondo Finance (+$13.9 million). Re (+$7.4 million) and f(x) Protocol (+$3.3 million). The top 10 added about $423 million combined.

images.alt: RWA Weekly Market Cap Report — figure 3

blocks.text: By chain, Ethereum added $166.8 million and Stellar $90.9 million. The two account for about 95% of the growth across the top 10. Monad (+$6.7 million), zkSync Era (+$3.1 million) and BNB Chain (+$1.9 million) followed. Plume Network (+$454,700), Solana (+$339,800), Robinhood Chain (+$238,300), OP Mainnet (+$178,000) and Plasma (+$106,900) each added under $1 million.

parts.text: Tokenized U.S. T-bills

WisdomTree (+$983,900), Circle (+$973,900), Matrixdock (+$164,400), Fidelity (+$159,500), OpenEden (+$94,300) and Libeara (+$73,000) each added under $1 million.

parts.text: Tokenized credit funds

parts.text: Conclusion

blocks.text: Stablecoins saw the largest growth of the week, led by Open Standard, Falcon Finance and Tether by issuer and by Tempo by chain. Tempo added more than twice as much as Tron, the next chain.
